Vulnerabilities.Title: braces: braces: Denial of Service via Stack Overflow from Deeply Nested Patterns
Vulnerabilities.Description: braces through 3.0.3 contains a stack overflow vulnerability in the recursive AST walkers that lack depth guards. Attackers can supply deeply nested brace patterns under the character limit to exhaust the call stack and terminate the Node.js process with an uncaught RangeError.

Vulnerabilities.Title: node-forge: node-forge: Signature forgery vulnerability in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification
Vulnerabilities.Description: node-forge through 1.4.0 fails to validate element count in nested DigestAlgorithm sequences during RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification. Attackers can embed garbage bytes inside the DigestAlgorithm sequence to forge valid signatures for arbitrary messages using low-exponent RSA keys. This is an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-33894.
